description: Get the organization webhook URL configuration (webhook_url, webhook_url_collection, webhook_url_file) via GET /v1/organization/{id}/webhooks. Requires a full API Access key. organization_id is optional and derived from the API key when omitted. See the webhooks guide. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_webhooks
